title: This royal family kept it in the family so long, their king couldn't chew 👑
caption:
The Habsburgs ruled Europe for 600 years. Then the family tree became a family wreath. 🌿
Tag your weirdest cousin 👇
sources: Vilas R. et al. (2019) 'Is the Habsburg jaw related to inbreeding?', Annals of Human Biology 46: 553-561 (link between inbreeding and mandibular prognathism)

Alvarez G., Ceballos F. C. & Quinteiro C. (2009) 'The role of inbreeding in the extinction of a European royal dynasty', PLoS ONE 4: e5174 (Charles II inbreeding coefficient 0.254; uncle-niece marriages)
